worst_flaw: The design gives every member of a team an hour of paid time off only if the whole team hits its target, and it removes valid exceptions from the article-rate denominator, which creates peer pressure and a motive to inflate exceptions; the QA sample may be too small to catch this, and the few randomized teams leave the incremental-lift estimate underpowered, while there is no replayable event log and appeals go only to the support lead.
